% --- CROSSLINK API (use these anywhere in the report) --------------------------
%   \dagref{lem-prh}      -> jumps to the atlas node for a registry result
%   \dagdef{def-height}   -> jumps to the atlas row for a definition
%   \dagphase{comp}       -> jumps to a phase page
% Anchors are \hypertarget{dag:<id>}; the scheme is documented in the atlas section.
\newcommand{\dagref}[1]{\hyperlink{dag:#1}{\texttt{#1}}}
\newcommand{\dagdef}[1]{\hyperlink{dag:#1}{\texttt{#1}}}
